description: This Java class provides helper methods to determine the visibility and permission states for sharing options in an Android notes application. It encapsulates logic to check permissions, determine share types (file drop, secure file drop), and retrieve permission descriptions and selected indices based on share permissions.

classes.name: SharingMenuHelper
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods for managing sharing permission UI logic.

methods.name: isUploadAndEditingAllowed
methods.description: Checks if upload and edit permissions are allowed on the share.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Determines if the share is read-only.

methods.name: isFileDrop
methods.description: Checks if the share permits file dropping.

methods.name: isSecureFileDrop
methods.description: Checks if the share permits secure file dropping.

methods.name: getPermissionName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable permission name based on the share's permissions.

methods.name: getPermissionCheckedItem
methods.description: Returns the index of the current permission setting within a list of permission options.

methods.name: getPermissionIndexFromArray
methods.description: Helper method to find the index of a specific permission string in an array.

methods.name: canReshare
methods.description: Checks if the share permits resharing.
